name: quetrex
description: Quetrex — an enforcement-first AI build system. Install quetrex to run work from your kanban; the guarded agent pipeline comes with it. Add a stack pack for your language.

plugins.name: quetrex
plugins.description: Drive your Quetrex board from your editor. Create, refine, build, merge, and deploy tasks with /quetrex:* commands. Installs the build engine (quetrex-factory) automatically — start here.

plugins.name: quetrex-factory
plugins.description: The guarded AI build engine. Specialist agents — architect → developers → QA → reviewer → security — carry each task to a reviewed, merged PR, with hooks that block anything red, unreviewed, or insecure from shipping. Stack-agnostic; add a stack pack for your language.

plugins.name: quetrex-nextjs
plugins.description: Next.js stack pack. App Router / TypeScript conventions + the tsc → eslint → next build → tests → Playwright E2E verify chain. Enable in a Next.js repo.

plugins.name: quetrex-python
plugins.description: Python stack pack. The ruff → mypy → pytest verify chain + Python-aware security lenses. Enable in a Python repo.

plugins.name: quetrex-rust
plugins.description: Rust stack pack. The cargo fmt → clippy → build → test verify chain + ownership/unsafe security lenses. Enable in a Rust repo.

plugins.name: quetrex-swift
plugins.description: Swift stack pack. The swiftlint → swift build → swift test verify chain + Keychain/URLSession/ATS security lenses. Enable in a Swift repo.
